records.title: A Survey on End-to-End Autonomous Driving Training From the Perspectives of Data, Strategy, and Platform
records.reason: Primary abstract read at https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00926: Surveys end-to-end autonomous driving training data, strategies and platforms; its subject and contribution are training ecosystem, not LLM inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: Vox-Infinity: Benchmarking the Limits of Long-Context Spoken Language Models
records.reason: Primary abstract read at https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22452: Introduces a benchmark for long-context spoken-language-model understanding and evaluates accuracy/recency effects; it does not propose or evaluate inference efficiency.

records.title: WeMM-Embedding: WeChat Multi-Modal Embedding Technical Report
records.reason: Primary abstract read at https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24053: Reports multimodal embedding models, training stages, retrieval benchmarks and deployments; not an LLM generation inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: GenRouter: Unified Workflow Routing for Agentic Image Generation
records.reason: Primary abstract read at https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16721: Routes agentic text-to-image generation workflows to reduce image-generation cost/latency. Despite explicit inference-efficiency gains, scope is image generation rather than LLM inference/serving.

records.title: ComBodied Agents: a New Paradigm of Human-Centric Agentic AI
records.reason: Primary abstract read at https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10915: Presents a human-centered agentic-AI paradigm, memory and intervention framework; no inference-time compression or efficiency contribution.
